question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Navjot Kaur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Navjot Kaur **is a prominent Indian field hockey player.
 
• She has represented India in multiple international tournaments and competitions.
 
• Navjot Kaur has been a part of the Indian women's hockey team that won the **silver medal at the 2018 Asian Games**.
 
• She plays as a midfielder and has contributed significantly to the team's performance over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Field Hockey**

 
 
• Field hockey is a team sport of the hockey family.
 
• The game can be played on grass, watered turf, artificial turf, or synthetic field, as well as an indoor boarded surface.
 
• Each team plays with ten field players and a goalkeeper.
 
• The objective of the game is to score more goals than the opposition.
 
• Field hockey is widely played across the globe, particularly in Europe, Asia, Africa, and Australia.
 
 
 
• **Asian Games**
 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The Games are regulated by the **Olympic Council of Asia** (OCA) under the supervision of the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• It is the second-largest multi-sport event after the Olympic Games.
 
• The **first Asian Games **were held in **New Delhi, India, in 1951**.
 
 
 
• **Midfielder in Hockey**
 
 
• A midfielder in field hockey is responsible for linking the defense and the attack.
 
• They are crucial in both defensive and offensive plays.
 
• Midfielders are often involved in intercepting passes, tackling opponents, and distributing the ball to attackers.
 
• They need to have excellent stamina, ball control, and passing skills.
